description: This file defines the BlockController class for Drupal, handling admin block routes including block operations and theme demo page rendering.

classes.name: BlockController
classes.description: Controller for managing Drupal block routes, including operations and theme demo pages.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BlockController with a theme handler.

methods.name: performOperation
methods.description: Performs an operation ('enable' or 'disable') on a block and redirects to the admin display.

methods.name: demo
methods.description: Generates a demo page for a specified theme, including visible regions.

methods.name: getVisibleRegionNames
methods.description: Returns a list of human-readable region names for a theme.
